evals.prompt: Triage my Reader inbox one item at a time and help me decide what to read, save for later, or archive.
evals.expected_output: A personalized Readwise Reader inbox triage flow that fetches inbox documents and presents one document at a time.
assertions: The response checks for `reader_persona.md` before presenting inbox items.
The response fetches Reader inbox documents from location `new` with a limit of 10.
The response presents one document at a time rather than dumping the full batch.
The response includes Read, Later, Archive, and Something else options.

evals.prompt: Help me clear my Readwise inbox. If I say later, move it to later; if I say archive, archive it.
evals.expected_output: An interactive triage loop that maps user responses to Reader move operations.
assertions: The response maps `Later` to `readwise reader-move-documents --location later`.
The response maps archive or skip responses to archive movement.
The response uses a visual separator before moving to the next document.

evals.prompt: Show me the first thing in my Reader inbox and pitch whether I should read it.
evals.expected_output: A single Reader document card with a concise pitch and honest skip reason.
assertions: The response includes an ASCII document card.
The response includes both `Why read` and `Why skip` sections.
The response fetches full document details only when the user asks for more detail.
